newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica share sale to be 60 pct retail.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica share sale to be 60 pct retail.

text.p: Spain will reserve 60 percent of its Telefonica shares for retail sales when the state offers its 21 percent stake in the telecoms operator early next year, Spanish financial media said on Thursday.
No-one at state holding company Sepa was immediately available to confirm the details of the share offer, which is due to be finalised in a week.

Local newspapers said the state would spend about 50.5 billion pesetas on incentives, commissions and publicity to sell its 197 million shares, which would gross some 564 billion pesetas at Telefonica's share price at 1015 GMT of 2,865.
Small investors are to get a four percent discount on the purchase price and one share for every 20 after the first year as incentives.
In addition to the 60 percent reserved for retail investors, some five or six percent is expected to be put aside for Spanish institutional buyers and the rest for foreign institutions.
